text.description_html:
Acorn PPDYP, Hand Painted Ceramic Square Rose Cabinet Pull

When everything seems like it is made by machine, Acorn offers ceramic pulls that are individually hand painted. The abstract rose of this cabinet pull will add a bit of whimsy to your home. The Hand Painted Ceramic Square Rose Cabinet Pull is available in two colors and each of those is available in large and small sizes. The large has a 4 inch center to center while the small has a 3 inch center to center. It can be mounted horizontally or vertically and it comes packaged with all the hardware need for installation.

Also Available:
Hand Painted Large Square Rose Cabinet Knob
Hand Painted Small Square Rose Cabinet Knob

Features of the Hand Painted Ceramic Square Rose Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Can be mounted horizontally or vertically.
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Available Types:

    PPDYP - Large Green Ceramic Pull With Square Mauve Rose:
    • Center to Center: 4"
    • Overall Length: 5-1/2"
    • Width: 1-1/4"

    PPEYP - Small Green Ceramic Pull With Square Mauve Rose:
    • Center to Center: 3"
    • Overall Length: 4-7/8"
    • Width: 1-3/16"

    PPKYP - Large Off White Ceramic Pull With Square Orange Rose:
    • Center to Center: 4"
    • Overall Length: 5-1/2"
    • Width: 1-1/4"

    PPLYP - Small Off White Ceramic Pull With Square Orange Rose:
    • Center to Center: 3"
    • Overall Length: 4-7/8"
    • Width: 1-3/16"

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
